metadata.content: Cheavon Clarke vs Chris Billam-Smith: 'C4' set for all-British cruiserweight bout at Copper Box Arena | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Cheavon Clarke vs Chris Billam-Smith: 'C4' set for all-British cruiserweight bout at Copper Box Arena Cheavon Clarke and Chris Billam-Smith resume their rivalry in the professional ranks as the main event on Zuffa Boxing 12 at the Copper Box Arena on November 7, live on Sky Sports Monday 19 October 2026 17:54, UK Image: Chris Billam-Smith and Cheavon Clarke (right) face off ahead of their November 7 fight, live on Sky Sports Cheavon Clarke insists he does not care about the amateur fight that Chris Billam-Smith finds "hard to watch". metadata.summary: Toto Wolff believes in-form Red Bull will be a central part of the "full-on fight" he is expecting at the front of the Formula 1 field into 2027.
metadata.content: F1: Toto Wolff says Max Verstappen, Red Bull resurgence adds to expectation of 'full-on fight' into 2027 season | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content F1: Toto Wolff says Max Verstappen, Red Bull resurgence adds to expectation of 'full-on fight' into 2027 season Mercedes are fast closing on a world championship double, but Red Bull are threatening to end the 2026 season with F1's fastest car after back-to-back wins for Max Verstappen; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin from Friday evening, live on Sky Sports F1 Monday 19 October 2026 16:23, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player On the Sky Sports F1 Show podcast, Bernie Collins praised Red Bull and their strategy after Max Verstappen's clean sweep in Singapore Toto Wolff believes in-form Red Bull will be a central part of the "full-on fight" he is expecting at the front of the Formula 1 field into 2027. Wolff's Mercedes team are closing in on a world championship double heading into the closing races of this season, with Kimi Antonelli able to clinch the drivers' title as early as this weekend's United States Grand Prix if results go his way. The strength of Mercedes' challenge in both championship races was built on a flying start to the season - which has been the first of the sport's new regulation era - with eight wins from the campaign's first 10 rounds. messages.text: Brook wants to be captain 'England fans can rely on'

metadata.summary: Harry Brook insists he wants to be a captain that "England fans and the team rely on" as we near the one-year anniversary of his altercation with a bouncer at a nightclub in New Zealand.
metadata.content: Harry Brook wants to be captain 'England fans can rely on', ODI skipper says ahead of Pakistan, Sri Lanka tri-series | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Harry Brook wants to be captain 'England fans can rely on', ODI skipper says ahead of Pakistan, Sri Lanka tri-series Harry Brook on nightclub incident in New Zealand last year: "I know it wasn't an ideal situation to put myself in, but I feel as a captain and a leader I've learnt a lot"; England's tri-series ODI vs Pakistan, live on Sky Sports Cricket, 8.30am, Tuesday (first ball 9am) Monday 19 October 2026 12:48, UK Image: Harry Brook says he wants to be a captain that 'England fans can rely on' Harry Brook insists he wants to be a captain that "England fans and the team rely on" as we near the one-year anniversary of his altercation with a bouncer at a nightclub in New Zealand. Brook was overlooked for the Test captaincy after Ben Stokes' international retirement this summer, while he's previously admitted that he could have been sacked as white-ball skipper for the incident in Wellington that occured just hours before an ODI against the Black Caps on Halloween last year. Since then, Brook has stabilised an ailing 50-over side, with England winning their last three series - having lost seven of eight prior - while his T20 team currently top the world rankings. messages.text: Merson: Brighton defeat scared Arsenal – they won’t beat Bayern

metadata.summary: The defeat to Brighton has scared Arsenal. After winning the league, they came out and played some entertaining football, but then that result happened and they’ve gone back to being an efficient machine.
metadata.content: Arsenal were spooked by Brighton defeat and have reverted to type - they won't beat Bayern Munich, says Paul Merson | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Arsenal were spooked by Brighton defeat and have reverted to type - they won't beat Bayern Munich, says Paul Merson Sky Sports' Paul Merson pens his latest column on Arsenal's attacking issues following their narrow win over Nottingham Forest; Arsenal face Bayern Munich in the Champions League on Wednesday; Eberechi Eze's struggles continue in the Premier League Paul Merson Football Expert & Columnist @PaulMerse Monday 19 October 2026 16:12, UK The defeat to Brighton has scared Arsenal. After winning the league, they came out and played some entertaining football, but then that result happened and they’ve gone back to being an efficient machine. It frightened them and they've reverted to type. And the type is that they won't let in any goals, and they'll make an opportunity to score a goal, and that's exactly what they did at Nottingham Forest. I don't think I've ever seen a game where a team has that much possession and still doesn't look like scoring a goal in a month of Sundays. It was as bad as it gets. metadata.content: United States GP: Lewis Hamilton and Lando Norris moving on from Singapore woes among talking points for Austin race | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content United States GP: Lewis Hamilton and Lando Norris moving on from Singapore woes among talking points for Austin race Kimi Antonelli could seal his maiden F1 drivers' title at this weekend's United States GP; Lewis Hamilton and Lando Norris are both looking to bounce back from controversies; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1 Monday 19 October 2026 06:09, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Karun Chandhok discusses how Red Bull have developed their cars into one of the quickest on the grid this season, particularly at Baku, Bahrain and Singapore. Formula 1 returns to Austin's Circuit of The Americas for the United States Grand Prix with a historic championship crowning potentially in the offing, along with several other hot topics on the agenda. All eyes on Antonelli as history beckons The event in Texas kicks off the second of three triple-headers to end the season, with races in Mexico and Brazil immediately following this one. There is every chance that Antonelli will become F1's youngest ever world champion on one of the next three Sundays, but it would require something quite dramatic for that to be in Austin.
